title: Waste-derived-lignin based hydrogel as a reusable adsorbent for efficient removal of dyes from aqueous solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25596-25613
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01545J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Umme Toufika Jannat, Md. Anamul Haque, Sharuk Alam Aumi, Swapan Kumer Ray, Mohammad Moniruzzaman, Md. Sarwar Jahan, Md. Aftab Ali Shaikh, Md. Qamrul Ehsan
A sustainable lignin/PVA hydrogel has been fabricated by integrating lignin, extracted from waste-black-liquor of pulp and paper processing, with poly(vinyl alcohol) as a high-performance adsorbent for dye-contaminated wastewater treatment.
